confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Phnom Penh price levels, not checked against live menus, listings or booking pages. Restaurant and beer anchors are the most reliable; the hostel, 3-star hotel, cocktail and wine anchors are less certain. Cocktail and wine were set at about 3-4x draft beer where direct knowledge is weak. Prices are largely USD-denominated, so no FX adjustment was applied. The FX figure comes from two rba.gov.au-restricted search results that agreed on the 15 Oct 2026 value; the RBA page itself was not read directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional Southeast Asian basis: compared with mid-priced, tourist-oriented capitals in the region and adjusted for Phnom Penh's USD-based price levels. No single comparable city was matched precisely.
